# BNC

> BNC is an apparel design and growth studio that builds clothing brands that sell: custom T-shirt and apparel design, brand identity, Shopify and print on demand stores, store SEO, Facebook and Instagram ad creatives, marketing strategy and social media management. Website: https://www.bncapparel.site/

## Services
- Custom T-shirt and apparel design for tees, hoodies and full collections (screen print, DTG, print on demand)
- Clothing brand identity: logo, color system, typography, labels, hang tags and packaging
- Print on demand setup and integration (Printful, Printify) with mockups and product sync
- Shopify, Wix and WordPress clothing store design
- Store SEO and speed optimization for apparel stores
- Facebook and Instagram ad creatives for clothing brands
- Digital marketing strategy and launch planning
- Social media management for Instagram and TikTok

## Selected work
- Dream in Defiance: apparel line, Printful integration and Shopify store for a YouTube creator with 300,000 subscribers, launched on schedule
- Hamrah: streetwear brand identity with calligraphy logo, graphic tees and packaging
- Apex Apparel: athletic sportswear brand identity
- Paragon: performance apparel identity, custom typeface, campaigns and packaging
- Slash-32, Stillski, Gretchen am Strand and a streetwear graphic tee series
- More work: https://www.behance.net/burhanbnc
